kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
نتهتلر (form IIq)
# نَتَهَتْلَرُ (natahatlaru) /na.ta.hat.la.ru/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَهَتْلَرَ (tahatlara)
# نَتَهَتْلَرَ (natahatlara) /na.ta.hat.la.ra/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَهَتْلَرَ (tahatlara)
# نَتَهَتْلَرْ (natahatlar) /na.ta.hat.lar/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَهَتْلَرَ (tahatlara)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
